proposed_widenings.name: passive_aura_magic_item
proposed_widenings.justification: Weapon of Warning is a non-spell persistent aura centered on the attuned wielder that affects self and nearby allies. MagicItemMechanics only allows PassiveMechanics or ActivatedAbilityMechanics; PassiveMechanics has no attachment, radius, subject-selection, or ongoing-operation slot, so any encoding would lie about scope.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As long as this weapon is within your reach and you are attuned to it, you and allies within 30 feet of you gain the following benefits.

proposed_widenings.name: Passive gate: weapon_within_reach
proposed_widenings.justification: The current passive-gating vocabulary only covers always / wearing_armor / wielding_weapon. Weapon of Warning turns on specifically while the item is within reach, which is not representable by those predicates.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As long as this weapon is within your reach and you are attuned to it ...

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger: on_combat_start
proposed_widenings.justification: The Alarm rider fires at a specific lifecycle boundary, combat start. No current ongoing trigger variant covers that event.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The weapon magically awakens each subject who is sleeping naturally when combat begins.

proposed_widenings.name: wake_sleep
proposed_widenings.justification: The item wakes subjects who are sleeping naturally but explicitly does not wake magically sleeping subjects. The current condition vocabulary has no natural-vs-magical sleep distinction, and remove_condition cannot express this selective wake effect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This benefit doesn't wake a subject from magically induced sleep.

notes: No content dhall/json/trace was written. The initiative rider itself would fit existing atoms as modify_roll_advantage on initiative, but the unit as a whole does not fit any current magic-item mechanics family honestly because it is a proximity-based passive aura with a combat-start wake rider.
